name: oap-driverecorder-next
description: Own Drive Recorder: records via its own AVB receiver (no icam2proxy video buffer), drives camera DR mode, saves clips on demand; renderer screens with a clip viewer (iDrive 7 and iDrive 8 layouts, touch or the iDrive controller), front end of the iteriodev-drplay player tool
author: IterioDev

store.description: Keeps the car's cameras recording and saves a clip when you ask; watch, lock, delete and copy clips to a USB stick while the car stands still. Works by touch or with the iDrive controller. Over 4 GB the oldest unlocked clips are replaced. The Store installs the Drive Recorder player with it. The car must be coded for the Drive Recorder.
